title: Flats and naturals
summary: Lowering a note, and cancelling a sign.

steps.title: Flats and naturals
text: A flat beside a note lowers it one fret. A **natural** sign cancels a sharp or flat, whether from earlier in the bar or from the key signature.

steps.title: E flat
text: **E flat** cannot be an open string. The high one is the 4th fret of the 2nd string. The low one is the 1st fret of the 4th string.

steps.title: Flats and naturals
text: In bar 2 the flat carries to the third note, and a natural cancels it on the fourth.
